definitions.gloss: to be grilled, to be roasted
definitions.explanation: For food to become cooked through grilling or roasting.
To be damaged or destroyed by fire or heat.
For skin to become darker or burned from sun exposure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{焼|や}けてしまった。

examples.english: The bread baked to a nice color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧{焼|や}けている⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦どうか→どうか：09854_douka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check whether the fish is grilled properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山火事|やまかじ}→山火事：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{焼|や}けた。
examples.english: The forest burned in a wildfire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{焼|や}けてしまった。

examples.english: In summer you get sunburned quickly when outside, so you should put on sunscreen.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {焼|や}く (transitive, to grill/burn). Pattern: Xが{焼|や}ける (X burns/is grilled).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {焼|や}けている = 'is burnt' or 'has been grilled.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{肉|にく}が{焼|や}ける (meat is grilled/done)
・{家|いえ}が{焼|や}ける (house burns down)
・{日|ひ}に{焼|や}ける (get sunburned)
・{焼|や}け{跡|あと} (burned remains)
・{夕焼|ゆうや}け (sunset glow)

CONTRAST:
・{焼|や}ける (intransitive): X burns/is grilled
・{焼|や}く (transitive): burn/grill X

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{日焼|ひや}け (sunburn, suntan—noun)
・{朝焼|あさや}け (morning glow)
